com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.taskmapping

Interface IEvent

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IHasModelObject, IIdentifiable, IModelAbstraction

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IEvent
extends IIdentifiable
    An event IEvent (called AbstractEvent in AUTOSAR) represents a RTEEvent or a BswEvent. Events are raised on different conditions and are used to implement application or basic software in AUTOSAR. (Sometimes they are also called triggers.)

      • getTriggerCondition

        @PublishedMethod
java.lang.String getTriggerCondition()
        Determines the trigger condition.
        The trigger condition depends on the event type:

        TIMING: The timing period in ms. Examples: "10ms", "50ms".
        INIT: No trigger condition.
        DATA_RECEIVED: Referenced data elements with port names. Examples: "MyPort.MyDataElement", "rNvPort.Element".
        DATA_RECEIVE_ERROR: Referenced data elements with port names. Examples: "MyPort.MyDataElement", "rSRPort.Element".
        DATA_SEND_COMPLETED: Referenced data elements with port names. Examples: "MyPort.MyDataElement", "pDataSend.Element".
        OPERATION_INVOKED: Referenced client server operations with port names. Examples: "MyPort.MyOperation", "pCSPort.Operation".
        SERVER_CALL_RETURNS: Referenced client server operations. Examples: "MyPort.MyOperation", "rCSPort.Operation".
        MODE_ENTRY: Referenced modes with mode groups and port names. Examples : "MyPort.MyModeGroup.MyMode", "rModePort.ModeGr.ModeB".
        MODE_EXIT: Referenced modes with mode groups and port names. Examples : "MyPort.MyModeGroup.MyMode", "rModePort.ModeGr.ModeB".
        MODE_TRANSITION: Referenced modes with mode groups and port names. Examples : "MyPort.MyModeGroup.MyMode", "rModePort.ModeGr.ModeB".
        MODE_SWITCH_ACK: Referenced mode groups with port names. Example: "MyPort.MyModeGroup".
        EXTERNAL_TRIGGER: Referenced external trigger element with port names. Example: "MyPort.MyTriggerElement".
        INTERNAL_TRIGGER: Name of executable entity owning the internal triggering point with the name of the triggering point itself. Example: "MyRunnable.MyInternalTriggering".
        BACKGROUND: No trigger condition.

        Returns:
        A textual representation of the trigger condition or an empty string, never null.
